title: We are upgrading to a new ERP system!
summary: We are launching a new global ERP system to improve efficiency, data accuracy and global integration across our facilities. The next implementation is planned for New Albany, Ohio in March 2026, with additional sites to follow through 2028. Learn more and stay updated here.
body_markdown:
## We are upgrading our Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) system across all global TriMas Packaging sites


As part of our ongoing commitment to enhancing service and operational excellence, we are pleased to announce the upgrade of our Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) system across all TriMas Packaging sites worldwide.


### Key Details


#### Atkins, Arkansas (USA) Go-Live:


- **Go-Live Date:** July 1, 2025 (Completed)
- **Location:** Atkins facility in Arkansas, USA – specializing in the manufacture of food caps
- **Contact:**[\[email protected\]](https://trimaspackaging.com/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection#94d5e1f6e1e6fad7e1e7e0fbf9f1e6d7f5e6f1d4e0e6fdf9f5e7baf7fbf9)


#### Leicester, United Kingdom Go-Live:


- **Go-Live Date:** September 1, 2025 (Completed)
- **Location:** Leicester facility in the United Kingdom – specializing in the manufacture of dispensing pumps and airless systems
- **Contact:**[\[email protected\]](https://trimaspackaging.com/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection#c68aa3afa5a3b5b2a3b485b3b5b2a9aba3b485a7b4a386b2b4afaba7b5e8a5a9ab)


#### New Albany, Ohio Go-Live:


- **Go-Live Date:** March 1, 2026
- **Location:** New Albany facility in Ohio, USA – specializing in the manufacture of dispensing pumps and sprayers
- **Contact:**[\[email protected\]](https://trimaspackaging.com/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection#b4fad1c3f5d8d6d5dacdf7c1c7c0dbd9d1c6f7d5c6d1f4c0c6ddd9d5c79ad7dbd9)


### **Future Implementations**


All other locations are scheduled for implementation in 2026-2028.


### Why This Matters


The new ERP system will deliver a range of benefits, including improved data accuracy, stronger integration across our global network, and enhanced efficiency in our processes. This upgrade represents a significant step forward in our efforts to deliver superior service to our valued customers.


### Stay Informed


We will continue to share updates on this page as the project progresses. No action is required from you at this time, but we encourage you to check back regularly for the latest updates.


### Stay Connected


If you have any questions regarding this upcoming change, please feel free to reach out to us.


Thank you for your continued support and partnership as we embark on this exciting transition.


#### Thank you for being a part of our TriMas Packaging community.
